title: Phase 17.1 Independent 2D Nonlinear Continuum Verification of Tapered Flexure

solver_formulations.continuum_solver: Total Lagrangian 2D Plane-Stress Continuum (Q4 elements with B-bar shear-locking relief)
solver_formulations.beam_solver: Corotational Nonlinear Frame Solver (Local Euler-Bernoulli with geometric coordinate updates)

scientific_integrity_conclusion: Under large-deflection loading from 0.25 N to 1.00 N, the independent 2D plane-stress continuum formulation and the corotational beam solver agree within a mean discrepancy of 3.94%. The cross-formulation concordance confirms that the tapered flexure model behaves as a physically sound elastic structure, though 3D anticlastic curvature and lateral-torsional effects remain outside 2D continuum scope.
